integrity.computational_basis: Independent brute-force enumeration of 11 complete-graph direct products via bundled Python 3 standard-library program.
integrity.proof_basis: Open-neighborhood incidence-cover equivalence; three-edge matching or same-side two-vertex cover; exact inclusion-exclusion.

scientific_limitations: Applies to products of precisely two complete graphs, each of order at least two.
Enumeration counts inclusion-minimal total dominating sets, not all total dominating sets or ordinary domination.
The k=1 specialization of an older upper k-tuple question is proved; k>1 is not addressed.
Small-graph exhaustions provide finite checks; the general argument uses Koenig matching-cover duality.
Residual literature-priority uncertainty remains for unindexed and inaccessible work.
title: Inclusion-minimal total domination of direct products of complete graphs
